correctness.rationale: Conditioned on alternating cyclic endpoints A,C,B,D, ordered gaps (x,y,z,w) have Dirichlet(1,1,1,1) density 6. Chord-line similarity gives exactly U=sin(pi x)sin(pi w)/(sin(pi x)sin(pi w)+sin(pi y)sin(pi z). The inequality U<t yields an explicit atan2 cutoff w*(x,y;t); for t<<x<<1 its first-order expansion and inner integral of sin(pi y)sin(pi(x+y))=1/2+O(x) produce (3/pi²)t log(1/t), and the x=O(t) and x bounded away 0 regions are lower order. Symmetry gives the upper tail and tail integration yields p<1. For marks x=t^a, u=tb the conditional Jacobian 6|log t| x t partial_u w tends after normalization to 2 sin²(pi y) on 0<a,b,y<1. Densities integrate to unity, so Scheffe gives total variation. Affine maps preserve the directed segment fraction and transform the sampling measure as stated.

value.rationale: An explicit singular endpoint law and independent logarithmic rare-event marks for the natural random intersection fraction of two chords; these characterize a different observable from intersection counts, crossing radii or crossing angles and determine negative moment thresholds.

final_claim: For independent angular-uniform circle chords AB and CD conditioned to cross, the directed division fraction U=|AP|/|AB| obeys P(U<t)~(3/pi²)t log(1/t) at the lower endpoint, with symmetric upper endpoint and inverse minimum-fraction moment finite iff p<1. Conditional near-endpoint marks (log X/log t,U/t,Y) converge in total variation to independent Unif(0,1), Unif(0,1), and density 2 sin²(pi y). Affine images retain the law under eccentric-anomaly sampling.
